svg.title: Space Drums roadmap
svg.desc: Twenty-four phases from project definition to final packaging. Phases 00 to 19 have their machinery built; phases 20 to 23 are planned; evidence from participants and live runs is still pending for most.
svg.text: ROADMAP · 24 PHASES · EACH ENDS AT AN OWNER-SIGNED EXIT GATE
built, evidence still pending (participants, live runs, sign-off)
